messages:
lee_dev: Quick one 914. Sample app using the JS SDK in our pnpm monorepo fails to bundle for edge. Works when I run inside packages/sdk but from apps/site it errors: "Could not resolve '@redwood/sdk'".

sara_devex: Yep. Often an exports map + pnpm hoist/symlink mismatch. Bundlers in edge mode sometimes resolve differently than Node, especially when package.json doesn't expose package.json or subpaths.

omar_build: Can you paste the SDK package.json exports? If it's just import/require pointing at dist, many bundlers can't find metadata. Example issue: 
"exports": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }

lee_dev: Real snippet: {"name":"@redwood/sdk","exports":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"}
Error: Could not resolve "@redwood/sdk" from /repo/apps/site/src/main.ts

nina_ts: Two quick fixes: 1) add "./package.json": "./package.json" to exports so bundlers can read it, 2) add wildcard exports "./*": "./dist/*" if you use subpath imports. Also consider a conditional export for edge specifically.

sara_devex: Example conditional exports: 
"exports": { "import": { "edge": "./dist/edge.mjs", "default": "./dist/index.mjs" }, "require": "./dist/index.cjs", "./package.json": "./package.json" }
This makes an explicit edge entry so bundlers pick the right runtime.

omar_build: TS can also complain: "Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk'" because tsc/tsserver resolves differently with pnpm. Make sure "types": "dist/index.d.ts" is present and consider typesVersions or exposing the d.ts at the package root for workspace consumers.

lee_dev: We also saw auth behavior broken only on edge preview (tokens stopped refreshing). Could this be bundler side-effect tree-shaking?

nina_ts: Exactly. If a side-effecting module (like auth/patch-fetch) is imported only via the node entry, bundler may drop it for edge. Put explicit import at top of edge entry: `import './auth/patch-fetch.js';` or add "sideEffects": ["./auth/patch-fetch.js"] in package.json.

sara_devex: Short-term dev workaround: create a tiny root proxy (index.mjs) that re-exports dist and run it in postinstall. Ugly but helps local workspaces and tsserver: `fs.writeFileSync('./index.mjs', "export * from './dist/index.mjs'\n");`

omar_build: CI suggestion: add a repo-root smoke job that runs `pnpm --filter apps/site build` to catch resolution issues early. I'll add to the monorepo CI template.

lee_dev: Thanks all. I'll open a PR with: add ./package.json export, edge conditional import, expose types, and CI smoke test. Will ping for review. :sparkles:

ci-bot: note: adding smoke build to CI will increase runtime ~3m.
